scope: P1_PREPARATORY_ONLY; ActionRegistry local schema subset, not scene integration

defect.hypothesis: Malformed or inapplicable constraints can survive schema registration and be ignored or changed during metadata JSON copy.
defect.patch: Validate own plain schema records, per-type allowed keys, unique string required fields, finite ordered numeric bounds, dense JSON enums with canonical identity and membership under remaining constraints.
defect.expected_observable_change: Malformed nested schemas reject before action registration; valid nested payloads retain restrictions and object enum identity is independent of key insertion order.

local_browser.observation: Pinned Playwright 1.56.1 is available; both Chromium 1194 and Headless Shell 1194 binaries are absent by filesystem checks. No launch retry; CI installs the locked runner.
